```swift title="Swift"

let _request = try LiterLlm.chatCompletionRequestFromJson("{\"messages\":[{\"content\":\"Hello\",\"role\":\"user\"}],\"model\":\"ollama/qwen2:0.5b\"}")
let result = try await LiterLlm.chat(request: _request)
print(result)
```
